text: Traces capture what an agent did in production, used for debugging, monitoring, and building eval datasets
quote: Traces are the record of what your agents did in production. Use them to debug failures, monitor quality, and build the datasets you evaluate against.

text: Traces can be filtered, exported, shared, and compared via UI or API
quote: Filter, export, share, and compare traces via the UI or API.

text: Can build dashboards and set alerts to track quality and catch issues early
quote: Build dashboards and set alerts to track quality and catch issues early.

text: Workflows can be automated with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations triggered on events
quote: Automate workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations.

text: Outputs can be annotated and user feedback gathered via annotation queues or inline annotation
quote: Annotate outputs and gather user feedback using queues or inline annotation.

text: LangSmith Engine automatically detects recurring issues in traces, diagnoses root cause, and helps resolve them
quote: Automatically detect recurring issues in your traces, diagnose their root cause, and resolve them with LangSmith Engine.

text: Datasets can be created from curated test cases, historical production traces, or synthetic data generation
quote: Create a dataset with examples from manually curated test cases, historical production traces, or synthetic data generation.

text: Evaluators can be created to score performance via human review, code rules, LLM-as-judge, or pairwise comparison
quote: Create evaluators to score performance: Human review, Code rules, LLM-as-judge, Pairwise comparison

text: Applications can be run against a dataset to create an experiment with configurable repetitions, concurrency, and caching
quote: Execute your application on the dataset to create an experiment. Configure repetitions, concurrency, and caching to optimize runs.

text: Evaluators can run automatically on prod traces for safety, format, quality checks, with filters/sampling for cost control
quote: Set up evaluators to run automatically on production traces: safety checks, format validation, quality heuristics, and reference-free LLM-as-judge. Apply filters and sampling rates to control costs.

text: Supports OpenTelemetry-based tracing so traces can be sent from any OTel-compatible application
quote: LangSmith supports OpenTelemetry-based tracing, allowing you to send traces from any OpenTelemetry-compatible application.

text: Provides threshold-based alerting on metrics like run count, cost, errors, feedback score, and latency
quote: LangSmith provides threshold-based alerting on the following metrics: Run Count, Cost, Errors, Feedback Score, Latency

text: Alerts can route to Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace, or any HTTP endpoint via webhook
quote: Alerts can route to Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace, or any HTTP endpoint via webhook.

text: Prebuilt dashboards are auto-created per project covering trace count, error rates, token usage, and more
quote: Prebuilt dashboards are created automatically for each project and cover essential metrics, such as trace count, error rates, token usage, and more.

text: Custom dashboards let users build tailored collections of charts for metrics that matter to them
quote: Create tailored collections of charts for tracking metrics that matter most for your application.

text: Data can be grouped by run tag or metadata to split metrics across attributes
quote: You can use group by run tag or metadata to split data over attributes that are important to your application.

text: LangSmith can be self-hosted in your own infrastructure for observability, evaluation, and prompt engineering, with optional managed agent deployment
quote: Host an instance of LangSmith in your own infrastructure for observability, evaluation, and prompt engineering. You can optionally enable LangSmith Deployment to deploy and manage agents through the LangSmith UI.

text: Provides an OpenAI client wrapper for automatic instrumentation of OpenAI calls
quote: client = wrap_openai(openai.Client())

text: Users can sign up and log in via Google, GitHub, or email without a credit card
quote: Sign up at smith.langchain.com (no credit card required). You can log in with Google, GitHub, or email.

text: Evaluations can be run on curated datasets during development to compare versions, benchmark performance, and catch regressions
quote: Run evaluations on curated datasets during development to compare versions, benchmark performance, and catch regressions.

text: Real user interactions can be evaluated in real-time to detect issues and measure quality on live traffic
quote: Evaluate real user interactions in real-time to detect issues and measure quality on live traffic.

text: Tracing supported via Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java SDKs, or integration with any agent stack/framework
quote: Trace your preferred framework or integrate LangSmith with any agent stack using our Python, Typescript, Go, or Java SDKs.
